g.text: 11 Launch Serving child in the Control container
Startup: mlflow-db healthy + minio-init success → MLflow; postgres, mongo, rabbitmq and MLflow healthy → migrate.
Migrate success gates Management, Relay, Supervisor and Control. Gateway waits for Control started. Both one-shots exit.
Ingestion and acceptance use optional overlays/profiles. Standalone external-mlflow uses separately supplied endpoints and role files.
Base: 5 long-lived app roles, 7 infrastructure services, 2 one-shots. ./var is shared; most app roles lack a Compose health check.
